Blood altar.note: The True Blood Altar, in the northern part of the Meiyerditch Laboratories. From Meiyerditch (56,51) the complete laboratory opens once the mutated bloodveld of Sins of the Father is killed; the inner laboratory rooms are reached through this record and carry the same gate, while the outer rooms Darkness of Hallowvale visits stay open. The trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog in Canifis (54,54) leads through the Myreque tunnels and the tomb of Ivandis to the end of the laboratory, a way the Wiki lists after Sins of the Father. The blood rift in the Abyss leads here once Sins of the Father is complete. Kourend's Blood Altar is a surface chunk of its own and is not changed.
